newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Santos portworkers to end strike - union.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Santos portworkers to end strike - union.

text.p: Administrative portworkers at the Brazilian port of Santos decided to end their strike and return to work at 0100 local/0400 GMT on July 3, a union official said.
"The strike is over, everybody is going back to work," the official said.
The portworkers stopped work at 0100 local/0400 GMT on July 1 in protest at not being consulted by the CODESP port authority over a shift to 24-hour operations at the port.

Because the portworkers involved in the stoppage monitor loading and unloading of vessels as well as provide technical assistance, the strike paralysed all operations in CODESP public berths, affecting sugar, soymeal and possibly coffee loading.
The decision to return to work was taken at an assembly this evening and followed a conciliatory meeting at the Sao Paulo Labor Tribunal between CODESP and union officials.
Despite strong disagreements between the two sides, the tribunal requested that workers suspend the strike immediately.
